To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Palm-Based Standard Reference Material (SRM) for iodine value (Wijs) and slip melting point are stable for one year at temperatures of − 20 °C, +0 °C, +6 °C and +24 °C.
the iodine values and slip melting point values of palm-based materials were determined and the consensus values and their associated uncertainty were obtained from the inter-laboratories tests.
the consensus values for iodine values and slip melting points of palm oil, olein and stearin were successfully determined.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of palm-based standard reference materials for iodine value, which is the most important parameter for the quality control of edible oil and fat, and slip melting point, which is the important physical property of fats and oils for the formulation of margarine and other shortenings.
the preparation of Palm-Based Standard Materials for Iodin Value and Slip Melts Point.
the production of Palm Based Standard Reference Materials for the characterization of iodine values and slip melting points of oils and fats.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Palm-Based Standard Reference Material for iodine value is stable and suitable for the purpose of calibration and control of iodine value of palm oil, olein and stearin.

the consensus values and their associated uncertainties for iodine value were 52.64 ± 0.13 Wijs for palm oil, 57.00 ± 0.11 Wijs for palm olein and for slip melting point were 35.5 ± 0.1 °C for palm oil, and 24.2 ± 0.5 °C for palm olein.
Palm-Based Standard Reference Material for Iodine value and Slip melting point are now available for use in the palm oil industry.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Palm-Based Standard Reference Material was successfully developed and is ready to be distributed for use.
the production of PalmBased Standard Reference Materials for the determination of iodine value and Slip Melting point was successfully achieved.
the Palm-Based Standard Reference Material is a good reference material for iodine value, slip melting point and other related properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the consensus values and their uncertainty of iodine values and slip melting points of palm oil, olein and stearin are now available.
the consensus values of iodine value and the slip melting point of Palm-Based Standard reference materials are in good agreement with the reference values.
the production of Palm Based Standard Reference Materials is possible, and the results of the inter-laboratories tests are acceptable.
